description: Cancel the active plan. Nothing else is charged; a purchase under 7 days and a paid period that has not started are refunded and end now, and the rest of the paid period stays active until keeps_until. Requires accept_data_removal: true. Send `{ "accept_data_removal": true }`. The monthly card subscription stops. A purchase made less than 7 days ago and a paid period that has not started yet, such as a renewal, go back the same way they were paid (card or Pix) and end now. The rest of the paid period stays active until `keeps_until`; then what the plan added ends (`account.cancel.losses` in `GET /api/plans` says what). A purchase paid with USDC or with credit from another purchase stays active until its end; ask for its refund by e-mail, as the cancellation page says.

accept_data_removal.description: Must be `true`: you accept losing what the plan added.

name: cancel_plan
title: Cancel plan
